items.title: DeepSearchQA: Bridging the Comprehensiveness Gap for Deep Research Agents
items.title_zh: DeepSearchQA：弥合深度研究智能体的全面性差距
items.summary: DeepSearchQA is a 900-prompt benchmark for evaluating agents on difficult multi-step information-seeking tasks across 17 fields, requiring exhaustive answer lists, de-duplication and reasoning about when to stop. Evaluations of state-of-the-art agent architectures reportedly show struggles to balance recall with precision, with failure modes including premature stopping and hedging.

items.title: Deep Researcher with Sequential Plan Reflection and Candidates Crossover (Deep Researcher Reflect Evolve)
items.title_zh: 具备序列化计划反思与候选交叉的深度研究智能体
items.summary: The paper proposes a Deep Researcher architecture that uses sequential research-plan refinement via reflection and a Candidates Crossover algorithm to maintain a global research context and synthesize findings from multiple LLM candidates. Powered by Gemini 2.5 Pro, it reportedly scored 46.21 on the 100-task DeepResearch Bench, surpassing several leading deep-research agents and marginally exceeding the authors' earlier Static DRA.

items.title: Planner-Auditor Twin: Agentic Discharge Planning with FHIR-Based LLM Planning, Guideline Recall, Optional Caching and Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: Planner-Auditor Twin：基于 FHIR 的 LLM 规划、指南召回、可选缓存与自我改进的代理式出院规划
items.summary: The paper presents a Planner-Auditor framework for clinical discharge planning in which an LLM planner generates structured plans with confidence estimates and a deterministic auditor checks coverage, calibration and drift on MIMIC-IV-on-FHIR data. The self-improvement loop reportedly raised task coverage from 32% to 86% and improved calibration.

items.title: C3Box: A CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning Toolbox
items.title_zh: C3Box：基于 CLIP 的类增量学习工具箱
items.summary: C3Box is a modular Python toolbox that unifies traditional, ViT-based and CLIP-based class-incremental learning methods in a single framework, with JSON-based configuration and a standardized execution pipeline. It is intended to make continual-learning experiments reproducible with low engineering overhead and to serve as a benchmark platform.

items.title: Evolutionary Strategies lead to Catastrophic Forgetting in LLMs
items.title_zh: 进化策略导致大语言模型灾难性遗忘
items.summary: The study analyzes evolutionary strategies (ES) as a gradient-free alternative for training LLMs and finds that ES can approach GRPO on math and reasoning tasks at comparable compute, but with significant forgetting of prior abilities. The authors attribute the difference to ES updates being much less sparse and having orders-of-magnitude larger L2 norm than GRPO updates.

items.title: INSURE-Dial: A Phase-Aware Conversational Dataset & Benchmark for Compliance Verification and Phase Detection
items.title_zh: INSURE-Dial：面向合规验证与阶段检测的阶段感知对话数据集与基准
items.summary: INSURE-Dial is described by the authors as the first public benchmark for compliance-aware voice agents, with 50 de-identified AI-initiated insurance calls and 1,000 synthetic calls annotated with a phase-structured schema. It defines phase boundary detection and span-based compliance verification tasks; per-phase scores are strong, but exact full-call segmentation on real calls remains low.

items.title: Llama-3.1-FoundationAI-SecurityLLM-Reasoning-8B Technical Report
items.summary: Foundation-Sec-8B-Reasoning is presented as the first open-source native reasoning model for cybersecurity, built on Foundation-Sec-8B and trained with supervised fine-tuning plus reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards. Across 10 cybersecurity and 10 general benchmarks it is reported competitive with larger models on security tasks while retaining general capabilities, and the model is released publicly.

items.title: Keeping your data safe when an AI agent clicks a link
items.title_zh: 当 AI 智能体点击链接时如何保护你的数据
items.summary: OpenAI describes safeguards intended to protect user data when AI agents open links, preventing URL-based data exfiltration and prompt injection.
